meta.name: study-teach
meta.description: Lecture & explanation sub-skill (orchestrated by study-assistant; also usable standalone). Use when the learner wants a chapter/section/knowledge point taught ("开始讲解" "讲一下第三章" "生成讲义" "继续下一个知识点"), asks a follow-up question about studied content, or says they didn't understand. Generates exactly one high-quality knowledge-point lecture at a time as structured JSON plus HTML/Markdown, then merges all completed points into one audited chapter-level main HTML. Must preserve source formulas, figures/tables, and worked examples when they help understanding.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将知识点转化为结构化讲义与讲解
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将学习内容整理成清晰讲义或讲解材料
copy.tagline_en: Turn knowledge points into structured lectures and explanations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to organize learning content into clear lecture notes or explanations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能按知识点生成讲义（JSON+HTML/Markdown），包含公式、图表、例题，并最终合并为章节讲义。还能回答学习中的追问，或用不同方式重新讲解。
howto.when: 当你说“开始讲解”“讲一下第三章”“生成讲义”“继续下一个知识点”，或追问已学内容、表示没听懂时触发。

say.text: 开始讲解第三章第一节
say.note: Claude 会生成该知识点的讲义文件。

say.text: 讲一下微积分基本定理
say.note: Claude 会按知识点生成讲义，包含公式和例题。

say.text: 刚才那个推导我没听懂，换个方式讲
say.note: Claude 会用不同的比喻或例子重新讲解。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates one knowledge-point lecture at a time (JSON + HTML/Markdown) with formulas, figures, tables, and examples, then merges all points into a chapter-level HTML. It also answers follow-up questions and re-teaches using different approaches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "开始讲解", "讲一下第三章", "生成讲义", "继续下一个知识点", ask a follow-up question about studied content, or say you didn't understand.

say_en.note: Claude generates a lecture file for that knowledge point.

say_en.text: Explain the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
say_en.note: Claude generates a lecture with formulas and examples.

say_en.text: I didn't get that derivation, explain it differently
say_en.note: Claude re-teaches using a different analogy or example.
